links.outcome: Initiation of PrEP care within 90 days (discussion, referral, or prescription fill) in randomized trial
links.effect: Nonsignificant increase overall (6.0% vs 4.5%, HR 1.32, 95% CI 0.84 to 2.1); HR 2.59 for HIV providers, 0.89 for non-HIV providers (P-interaction <0.001).
links.quote: There was a nonsignificant increase in initiation of PrEP care in the intervention arm (6.0% vs 4.5%, HR 1.32, 95% CI: 0.84 to 2.1).

screen.reason: Cluster randomized controlled trial assessing the real-world clinical deployment and impact of an EHR risk-prediction-guided clinical decision support tool versus usual care.

primary.practice: EHR-based clinical decision support alerts with risk thresholding
